credit: LegendCraft - the INVISIBLE carrier skin. For carrier entities whose visual is a mounted display model: a thrown snowball ignores the invisibility flag client-side, so the carrier wears this instead (ThrowableProjectile#setItem). It is a normal single-layer model over a fully transparent texture, NOT minecraft:empty: an empty model has no sprite, and the client's own impact particles (vanilla Snowball broadcasts entity event 3 and spawns ITEM particles from the carried stack) then fall back to the missing-texture checkerboard. A transparent layer renders nothing and gives those particles a sprite to sample.
